title: DORA ICT Incident Classification & Reporting Engine
description: Deterministic DORA ICT incident classification engine applying all 7 RTS 2024/1772 materiality criteria with correct compound classification logic (Condition A: criticality prerequisite + Condition B1/B2). Computes Major/Significant/Minor classification, calculates 4-hour/72-hour/1-month UTC reporting deadlines with live countdown, drafts ITS 2025/302 Annex I initial notifications, and flags threshold proximity warnings. AP2 JSON incident_classification_mandate export. Client-side. Zero PII.

classification_time.description: 4-hour reporting clock starts from this timestamp

entity_type.description: One of 20 DORA Article 2(1) entity types

ongoing.description: If true, treated as >24h for classification purposes

data_losses.description: confirmed_breach alone triggers Condition B1 for Major classification

criticality_of_services.description: Must be critical_adversely (Major) to satisfy Condition A — prerequisite for Major classification

mcp_tool_definition.name: classify_dora_ict_incident
mcp_tool_definition.description: Classify ICT incidents under DORA RTS 2024/1772 materiality thresholds using correct v3 compound classification logic. Implements all 7 criteria with Condition A (criticality prerequisite) AND Condition B1 (data breach) or B2 (2+ criteria at Major). Computes exact 4h/72h/1-month UTC reporting deadlines. Note: intermediate_report_utc is 72h from initial notification submission, not from classification time. Drafts ITS 2025/302 Annex I initial notification. Flags threshold proximity warnings. Use when an operations or technology risk team needs to formally classify a candidate DORA ICT incident.

threshold_source: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/1772 — embedded as DORA_RTS_THRESHOLDS const
classification_logic_version: v3 — compound condition (Condition A + B1/B2), all 7 criteria
regulatory_citations: DORA — Regulation (EU) 2022/2554, Articles 17–20 (incident management and reporting)
Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/1772 — RTS on ICT incident classification (7 criteria)
EU Regulation 2025/302 (ITS) — standard forms for major ICT incident reporting (Annex I, published 20 Feb 2025)
EBA/EIOPA/ESMA Joint Guidelines on estimation of aggregated costs/losses (JC 2024-34)
UK FCA PS21/3 — operational resilience (aligned UK framework)
